literal: In this birth we will not separate, as soon as I said, her eyes filled with tears.
translation: When I said, 'We will not part in this life,' her eyes immediately filled with tears, fearing that we might part in the next.
modern: "இப்பிறப்பில் நாம் பிரிய மாட்டோம்" என்று நான் சொன்ன உடனே, அவள் கண்கள் நிறையக் கண்ணீர் கொண்டாள்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates a delicate nuance of a lovers' tiff. When the hero reassures his beloved by saying they will not separate in this life, she immediately focuses on what he did not say. She interprets his words to mean that they might separate in future births, which fills her with sorrow. Consequently, her eyes instantly well up with tears, showing her longing for an eternal, uninterrupted union across all births.
